mentions.name: Hajime
mentions.description: Hajime is a personal static site generator being upgraded with better Obsidian support, aiming to serve as a solid Obsidian Publish alternative. Its main focus is capturing relationships between entries, the core feature of Obsidian.
mentions.problem: The SSG previously lacked strong Obsidian support; the goal is to make it a somewhat solid Obsidian Publish alternative, centered on relationships between entries.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on adding better Obsidian support to my personal SSG – Hajime [1], in an effort of making it a somewhat solid Obsidian Publish alternative.

The main point is adding relationships between the entries, as that's the bread and butter of Obsidian.
